The '''''Thalassa''''' was a [[Praetor Mark II-class battlecruiser|''Praetor Mark II''-class battlecruiser]] in the service of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sander Delvardus]].

==History==
The ''Thalassa'' was one of the few ''Praetor Mark II''s created, since the Empire favored Star Destroyer and dreadnought designs over battlecruisers. It was built and commissioned at some point after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEGTW" />

Decades later, the ''Thalassa'' was used by Delvardus in his warlord campaign after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. At the [[seizure of Moorja]], the battlecruiser engaged a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] fleet consisting of [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigates]] supported by [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing bombers]]. The combined force destroyed the ''Thalassa'' over [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]].<ref name="TEGTW" />
This was but one of a string of defeats suffered by Delvardus and he was soon pushed out of his conquered territory on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="DOAE2">{{SW|url=news/the-imperial-warlords-despoilers-of-an-empire-part-2|series=The Imperial Warlords: Despoilers of an Empire|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
